EBD.medhubName: (2023) EBD EPA (n): (topic), e.g. "(2023) EBD EPA (5): (HeadNeck Trauma)"
introduction: This is a FORMATIVE assessment to be conducted by a faculty member who directly observed the trainee while co-managing the case.
The case can be chosen by the trainee in consultation with the faculty.
The faculty should conduct an Entrustment-Based Discussion (EbD) as soon as possible after the completion of the case.
After conducting the EbD, please document the trainee's discussion with faculty and reflections on the case.
Please grade the trainee on the 9-point scale based on descriptors below.
Please comment on what the trainee did well and can be improved upon.
Please also record the supervision level that you would theoretically entrust the trainee with for this particular EPA.

Complexity of Case

Facilitates patient's telling of history; Effectively uses questions / directions to obtain information needed; Responds appropriately to affect, non-verbal cues. Follows efficient, logical sequence during physical examination. Orders and interprets investigations appropriately. Prescribes appropriate preoperative patient preparation
Effective and thorough when utilizing resources in the patient care environment e.g. drugs, equipment, manpower.

Generates an appropriate problem list / list of differential diagnoses; Selects appropriate anaesthetic and adjuvant drugs and techniques to provide rational, appropriate, patient-centered and cost-effective patient care.
Explains rationale for test / treatment; Obtains patient's consent, educates / counsels regarding management; Checks for understanding.

Demonstrates clarity of information when communicating with fellow healthcare professionals; Is polite. Coordinates multi-disciplinary efforts in overall patient care. Demonstrates comprehensive and legible medical records.
Demonstrates good theoretical knowledge and practical skill; "Good Hands"; Appreciates pitfalls; Recognizes complications; Formulates contingency plan.

Considers risks, benefits when formulating patient care plan; Recognizes and responds appropriately to significant changes in patient condition; Provides consultative support for patients who are critically ill.
Prioritizes (Critical tasks); Is timely and succinct without being brusque or abrupt; Organizes interaction and workflow efficiently.
Respects comfort and modesty of patient, non-judgmental and non-condescending towards patient and staff, Considers patient preference.
Demonstrates judgment, synthesis, caring, effectiveness, efficiency, safety.
